options.prompt:
## Okinawa, September 2036.

The world has changed.

Advanced fighters, autonomous drones, artificial intelligence and immersive simulators have transformed military aviation.

But becoming a fighter pilot is still brutally difficult.

Few places are more prestigious than Skyward Fighter Academy.

Located on the subtropical island of Okinawa, Japan, the academy brings together talented students from across the world. Here, future military pilots live, study and compete under the same roof.

The academy exists for one purpose:

To find the pilots capable of reaching the very top.

Students are tested in academics, physical training, simulators, navigation, formation flying, air combat, emergency procedures and competitive flight evaluations.

And the competition is relentless.

999 students.

Five Aces.

Only one can stand at the top.

You are one of the academy's newest students.

Your journey begins today.

After arriving on campus, you stand before the entrance to Skyward Fighter Academy. Beyond the gates, the sprawling campus stretches toward the distant coastline. Fighter aircraft can be heard taking off somewhere beyond the buildings.

You look down at your new student ID.

## Okinawa, September 2036.

The world has changed.

Advanced fighters, autonomous drones, artificial intelligence and immersive simulators have transformed military aviation.

But becoming a fighter pilot is still brutally difficult.

Few places are more prestigious than Skyward Fighter Academy.

Located on the subtropical island of Okinawa, Japan, the academy brings together talented students from across the world. Here, future military pilots live, study and compete under the same roof.

You've already spent years here.

You know the classrooms.

You know the instructors.

You know which simulator rooms are always occupied, which squadron lounges stay loud until midnight and which students you should never challenge to a flight evaluation.

More importantly, you know the competition.

999 students.

Five Aces.

Every ranking, every evaluation and every victory can change where you stand.

The new academic year is beginning.

Students are returning from across the world, aircraft are being prepared in the hangars and the academy is already buzzing with rumors about the coming competitions.

You walk through the familiar entrance of Skyward Fighter Academy.

The Okinawan sun shines through the enormous glass windows, illuminating the polished floors of the main hall.

You've been here before.

But this year will be different.

You look down at your academy ID.
